notes: Food Code is a USDA-specific categorical identifier for foods. It should be stored as a concept in the observation table, but requires mapping to a Standard Concept (e.g., SNOMED or a custom vocabulary) as no direct OMOP standard concept_id exists for USDA food codes.
Short Food Code Description is a text label for the food code. It is stored as a string in the observation table, as it provides contextual information not captured by a standard concept_id.
Long Food Code Description is a detailed text label for the food code. It is stored as a string in the observation table, providing additional descriptive context for the dietary observation.
